value.rationale: The result identifies a natural and counterintuitive structural boundary: a standard second-order accuracy upgrade assembled entirely from positivity-preserving backward-Euler solves loses positivity for every sufficiently small positive step on a canonical five-state Markov chain, then regains it at an exact algebraic threshold. The complete N=2 through N=5 hierarchy and exact re-entry window make the fact reusable for method selection and monotonicity analysis.
